backend/main.mo: Defines data types for profiles, trips, mechanics, posts, groups, and events, with compare functions and CRUD-like methods protected by access control.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature changes with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for theme and UI updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries for numerous frontend files including pages, components, and dialogs.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using an orange‑forward palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts and mounting the React application root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes, layout, theme provider, and profile setup gating based on authentication.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity login/logout button handling authentication state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal form prompting first‑time users to create their profile with name and optional bio.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Wrapper that shows a sign‑in prompt when users attempt to access protected content without authentication.
Renders the site logo linking to the homepage with an image and wordmark.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Reusable empty‑state card component with optional hero image, icon, description, and action.
frontend/src/components/events/CreateEve: Modal form for creating an event, validating input and submitting via useCreateEvent.
frontend/src/components/events/EventCard: Displays event info in a clickable card that navigates to the event detail page.
frontend/src/components/feed/FeedPostCar: Shows a feed post with author info, timestamp, and content.
frontend/src/components/feed/PostCompose: Authenticated text composer for creating new feed posts with validation.
frontend/src/components/groups/CreateGro: Modal form for creating a group with name and description fields.
frontend/src/components/groups/GroupCard: Clickable card summarizing a group’s name, description, and member count.
Main layout with header, navigation links, mobile menu, and authentication-aware controls.
frontend/src/components/marketing/FaqSec: FAQ section rendering expandable questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Timeli: Marketing timeline displaying milestone cards with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/mechanics/Mechan: Displays mechanic info with rating, specialties, contact details, and a button to initiate contact.
Modal dialog allowing users to submit a mechanic request, handling authentication, validation, and request mutation.
frontend/src/components/trips/TripSugges: Shows a trip suggestion with route, duration, type badge, and optional waypoint badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching, saving, and retrieving user profiles using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides queries and mutations for fetching events and creating, joining, or leaving events.
frontend/src/hooks/useFeed.ts: Fetches the feed and allows creating new posts with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroups.ts: Manages group-related queries and mutations including fetching, creating, joining, and leaving groups.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identities, and exposing identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMechanics.ts: Provides hooks for fetching mechanics, creating mechanic requests, and getting user mechanic requests.
frontend/src/hooks/useProfileOverview.ts: Fetches a consolidated overview of a user's profile, posts, groups, events, and mechanic requests.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file exporting nothing; queries are grouped in feature-specific hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useTripSuggestions.ts: Mutation hook that requests trip suggestions from the backend based on parameters and trip type variants.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme color variables and brand-specific component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with hero, mission, values, and story sections using cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact options with cards and links, plus additional support information.
frontend/src/pages/EventDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed event info with join/leave actions, authentication checks, and date formatting.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: Lists upcoming events with sorting, creation dialog, and sign-in prompt for event creation.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Displays group details with join/leave actions, membership state, and basic group info.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Displays groups, handles authentication for creating groups, and shows a sorted grid or empty state with a create dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page presenting hero content, feature cards, and onboarding steps.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsPage.tsx: Fetches and lists mechanics, allowing users to open a contact dialog or see an empty state if none exist.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPage.tsx: Static privacy policy page outlining data practices, rights, and platform policies.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Authenticated user profile page showing user info and tabs for posts, groups, events, and requests.
frontend/src/pages/SocialFeedPage.tsx: Shows a social feed with a post composer and sorted posts or an empty state.
frontend/src/pages/TripPlannerPage.tsx: Trip planner form that validates inputs, requests trip suggestions, and displays results or an empty state.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing) and persisting them in sessionStorage, plus utilities for clearing stored or hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and container settings, including extended theme values and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state, including scope, branding notes, and a list of existing high-level features with their requirement IDs.
